notes.title: [0.2.1 Patch Note] – 1st Update (complete)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="xsuBGwWRmOE;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hello, Everyone



Thank you for all the interest and feedback you’ve given to PUMP IT UP RISE.

Based on your suggestions, we have prepared our first official update, including new songs, the tutorial feature, and several system improvements.


■ Update Schedule
• Date: July 29, 2025 (Tuesday)

• Maintenance Time: 14:00 – [strike]16:00[/strike] 15:14 (KST)



※ To ensure stable data saving, the following restrictions will apply before the maintenance begins.

10 minutes prior: Division Challenge will become unavailable

3 Minutes prior: Warm-Up/Division Station will become unavailable, and new logins will be restricted




■ Main Update Details

1. New Song Update (4 songs)
1) Entrance (PIU Edit)

• Artist: Ice

• BPM: 180

• Channel: VARIETY



2) Aragami

• Artist: xi

• BPM: 48~196

• Channel: VARIETY



3) Transmission

• Artist: Sakuzyo

• BPM: 100~225

• Channel: RISE



4) Chess and Chase

• Artist: litmus* ft. CielA

• BPM: 128

• Channel: RISE




2. Tutorial (Beta)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601635/76dac0393361d8e6a5b0eb2ee6e0e67fc22973bb.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601635/3ba4782591ead47a9743009e36d690e4b97538ee.png"]

• New users will automatically enter the tutorial on their first login.

• Players can adjust and save their note timing through a short gameplay session.

• The tutorial can be replayed at any time via: OPTION > GAMEPLAY > TUTORIAL

※ When changing the audio playback device, proceed with the tutorial to correct the output timing again.




3. Other Changes
• Makeup & Option confirm key changed: TAB → ENTER

• ESC key added to skip the result screen

• Display settings: 360FPS and 540FPS options added

• Volume adjustments now provide real-time feedback (Master / BGM/ SFX)




4. Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
• Fixed game launch errors caused by conflicts with certain NVIDIA drivers

• Fixed an issue where FLOOR info in Division Station leaderboards was resetting

• Fixed incorrect leaderboard registrations outside of Division channels

• Adjusted the achievement condition for COMBO 2000

• Fixed translation and typographical errors



We will continue providing a more refined service through regular updates.

Thank you again for your continued feedback and support.



Thank you.

notes.title: [0.1.2 Patch Note] – Settings and Convenience Improvements (complete)
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone 

Thank you for all the interest and feedback you’ve given to PUMP IT UP RISE.



We are currently preparing version 0.1.2, which aims to improve the overall gameplay experience based on your suggestions.



This patch includes enhancements to timing/sync-related settings, clearer in-game explanations, and adjustments to the reward system.

Please note that once the patch is applied, previous versions of the game will no longer be accessible. Be sure to update to the latest version before playing.



■ Update Version

Version: 0.1.2

Maintenance Date: July 17, 2025 (Thu)

Maintenance Time: 15:00 – [strike]15:30[/strike] (15:21) (KST) *Estimated 30 minutes

※ As the maintenance time approaches, the following restrictions will be applied to ensure stable data saving:

• 10 minutes before maintenance: Division Challenge will become unavailable

• 3 minutes before maintenance: Warm-Up/Division Station will become unavailable, and new logins will be restricted



■ Main Improvements and Changes

1. Added Option to Toggle Miss Music Effect

   • The low-pass filter effect on MISS judgment can now be turned on or off in the settings.

      Location: Settings > Gameplay > \[Miss Music Effect]

   • Default setting: OFF

2. Added Tooltips for Note Output Time / Judgement Time

   • When hovering over “Note Output Time” and “Judgement Time” in Settings > Gameplay,

      tooltips will now display to explain each option’s function.

3. Unlock Requirement Display for Level-Locked Songs

   • When selecting a locked song, a pop-up will now show the level required to unlock it.

4. Expanded Note Output Time Range

   • Before: -100 ~ +100

   • After: -200 ~ +200

5. Adjusted EXP Gain Structure in Warm-Up Station

   • Rhythm Pass EXP and Account Level EXP can now also be earned in the Warm-Up Station,

      equivalent to the Division Station.

   The following conditions remain unchanged  :

   • No EXP is awarded for broken grades (Clear Failed).

   • Plates (FULL COMBO or higher) and BGAs (NO MISS or higher)

      can only be unlocked through Division Station play.



■ Other Bug Fixes

   • Network stability improvements

   • Fixed some translation errors



This patch focuses on addressing issues that have a direct impact on gameplay.

Additional feedback and reports from players will be reviewed and addressed through future updates.

We will continue to listen to your feedback and improve the game.



Thank you.
